target.statement: For a mixture of k=3 Dirac distributions with p=q=2 and full-rank group centers, the threshold group proportion below which the first ICS eigenvalue (COV^{-1}COV4) exceeds 1 is approximately 18%.
target.table_ref: Fig. 6 (Setup 1, k=3) / Table 1 in Appendix B.2
target.dataset: Synthetic mixture of Dirac distributions (no real data)

compute.basis: The target is a simple numerical threshold computed from closed-form scatter matrices for a 2D Dirac mixture; the grid search over proportions is trivial and runs in seconds on a CPU.

title: Invariant Coordinate Selection and Fisher discriminant subspace beyond the case of two groups
